items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Brasley. Brasley from here and I'm from here.

ctx.x: Is that any fellas from here much? Yeah, I was a drummer, there I am there.
Where did they come from? None of these fellas from here but me. Well, how many else? Brasley. Brasley from here and I'm from here.
